Definition: from G1537 and G3726; to exact an oath, i.e. conjure:--adjure.
BiblicalUsage: The word exorkízō carries the sense of adjure. In Matthew 26:63, the text says "I adjure thee by the living God."
TheologicalSignificance: I read exorkízō plainly — it means adjure, and I do not build a doctrine on it.
RelatedEvents: The Last Supper; Jesus Before the Sanhedrin
